messages.subject: Infrastructure & Energy Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Griffiths,

Novare's retained search work across global infrastructure, energy, power and utilities makes this a relevant introduction for senior leadership mandates.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications, alongside exposure to large-scale renewable energy, battery storage and infrastructure investment.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where infrastructure strategy, regulatory credibility, institutional relationships and responsible growth intersect. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC, while I remain internationally mobile for broader global opportunities.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for relevant current or future searches.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
